descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S18 「一个放好的框，带医嘱、改药和 'Task:' 暗号，不建任务、不建用药行、不生成记录」 A placed box with orders, a med change and a 'Task:' code word creates no task, no medication row and no note

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 Assigning does not create tasks, record medication events, or generate a note. Those happen only when the physician opens that patient's Encounter tab and taps Save & Extract.（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 7）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given QA Hosp Patel (415), no tasks, no medications, no note

When Place 'Bed 415. Start lisinopril 10 mg daily. Hold metoprolol for heart rate in the 50s. Recheck BMP in the morning. New admission from the ED today. Task: call daughter at 5 pm.' with Link, wait 5 s, open Patel's Encounter, Pre-Round and Post-Round tabs

Then Text is in the encounter note; Tasks empty (the code-word clause too, although its capture needs no model); Medications empty; no note generated. Tasks and medication events appear only after Save & Extract (S26)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: cp1 Encounter mustContain the full text and 'No pending tasks' — a code-word task 'call daughter at 5 pm' would replace 'No pending tasks'; a page-wide mustNotContain is not used because the note itself holds the words (oracle.mjs has no section scope); cp2 Pre-Round mustContain 'No medications recorded yet.'; …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U03；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S18 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
